U.S. News
// 14 minutes ago
FSU linebacker Ethan Pritchard 'stable' but 'critical' after gun attack
Sept. 1 (UPI) -- Florida State's Ethan Pritchard was listed in critical but stable condition after a gun shot attack while visiting family in the north Florida panhandle.
U.S. News
// 1 hour ago
Mueller's testimony on Epstein excused after Parkinson's revealed
Sept. 1 (UPI) -- Former FBI chief and special counsel Robert Mueller will not testify Tuesday before a House Oversight Committee hearing on the Jeffrey Epstein document saga due to Parkinson's disease.
U.S. News
// 3 hours ago
Xi, Putin, Modi signal unity against U.S.-led dominance
Sept. 1 (UPI) -- China's President Jinping Xi told Eurasian nations to unite against a global order led by the United States during the Shanghai Cooperation Organization summit.
U.S. News
// 13 hours ago
1 dead, 3 injured in midair plane collision in northeastern Colorado
Sept. 1 (UPI) -- One person is dead and three others were injured following two planes colliding midair as they attempted to land at a northeastern Colorado airport over the weekend, authorities and officials said.
U.S. News
// 18 hours ago
Rudy Giuliani hospitalized after N.H. car crash
Aug. 31 (UPI) -- Rudy Giuliani was hospitalized with a fractured vertebrae following a car crash in New Hampshire, his head of security announced Sunday.
U.S. News
// 19 hours ago
DHS head Noem confirms ICE increase in Chicago
Aug. 31 (UPI) -- Homeland Security Secretary Kristi Noem on Sunday confirmed the Trump administration plans to increase immigration resources in Chicago amid a planned federal crackdown on crime in the city.
U.S. News
// 21 hours ago
Powerball jackpot climbs to $1.1B, fifth-largest in game's history
Aug. 31 (UPI) -- The Powerball jackpot rose to a $1.1 billion jackpot after no tickets matched all six numbers in Saturday's drawing. The next drawing is set for Labor Day.
U.S. News
// 22 hours ago
Federal judge blocks mass deportation of Guatemalan children
Aug. 31 (UPI) -- A federal judge in Washington on Sunday temporarily blocked the Trump administration from deporting a group of Guatemalan children in U.S. custody.
U.S. News
// 22 hours ago
'Walking Tall' sheriff may have killed wife, Tenn. police say
Aug. 31 (UPI) -- The Tennessee sheriff who inspired the "Walking Tall" movie franchise may have shot his wife to death in 1967, state investigators said, citing new evidence.
U.S. News
// 1 day ago
Trump to mandate voter I.D. through executive order
Aug. 31 (UPI) -- President Donald Trump announced late Saturday that he would sign an executive order requiring voters to present identification when casting ballots.
